plugin_desc: Linksys Business / Smart Switch SNMP 采集模板（企业号 3955，树 1.3.6.1.4.1.3955.1000.201）。除标准 IF-MIB 64 位接口流量外，采集 5 分钟 CPU 使用率（rlCpuUtilDuringLast5Minutes，0–100%，101 丢弃）、风扇状态（rlEnvMonFanState）、电源状态（rlEnvMonSupplyState，normal=1，warning/critical/shutdown/notFunctioning=2，notPresent 丢弃）、机箱温度（rlEnvFanDataTemp，℃）和风扇转速（rlEnvFanDataSpeed，RPM）。私有 MIB 未暴露内存 Gauge，故内存为 N/A。适用型号：Linksys Business / Smart Switch。
name: Switch

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: 5-minute CPU utilization of the Linksys Business switch (rlCpuUtilDuringLast5Minutes, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3955.1000.201.1.9.0), stored as 0-100 percent. Value 101 (dummy / not measured) and any value outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each Linksys stack unit (rlEnvFanDataTemp, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3955.1000.201.83.5.1.1.2), in degrees Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Linksys cooling fan (rlEnvMonFanState): normal(1) stays 1; warning(2)/critical(3)/shutdown(4)/notFunctioning(6) map to 2 (abnormal); notPresent(5) and other codes are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Linksys power supply (rlEnvMonSupplyState), normalised the same way as fan state: 1=normal, 2=abnormal; notPresent and unknown codes are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed of each Linksys stack unit (rlEnvFanDataSpeed, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3955.1000.201.83.5.1.1.3), in RPM. Values below 0 or above 30000 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).
